definition: MIMIC sample k refits the whole system on a different MIMIC-IV patient sample: the JEPA training cohort and the frozen expert-anchor recipes

jepa_cohort.source: canonical_event_ledger_extract.py --database mimiciv --max-stays 5000 --sample k (MIMIC-IV 3.1 icustays with stay > 6 h)
jepa_cohort.sample_0: first 5000 eligible stays by stay_id (the original cohort; reproduced exactly by the --sample 0 code path)
jepa_cohort.sample_k: first 5000 eligible stays ordered by md5('multi_sample:k:' || stay_id); independent draws (about 5% stay overlap with sample 0)

anchors: build_expert_anchor_columns.py --sample k: deployment_recipes_20261024.json fitted on multi_sample_external_audit.mimic_sample(sample=k), 15,000 rows, JEPA-cohort subjects of sample k excluded
external_rows: unchanged: eicu_canonical_event_examples_full_5000, nwicu_canonical_event_examples, zigong_canonical_event_examples (unit harmonization by prepare_jepa_event_examples.py, inputs in order mimiciv, eicu, nwicu, zigong)
training: teacher_anchored_joint_jepa_audit.py with the sample-0 arguments (seeds 7,19,31,43,57,71,97; --max-stays 20000 keeps every stay)
gate: jepa_gate.py over samples 0-4; a database:cell is robust if all 7 seeds pass in >= 4 of 5 samples
